question:
Study the given pie chart and answer the question that follows:

The given pie chart shows the distribution (degree wise) of students in a college playing different sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72e4fa977a05d4600935c4138c2b1e92655dee2c599da37442c447fcdccc309e.png] 

The difference between the number of students playing chess and badminton is x. The value of x lies between:
solution:
**Concept:**

Number of student in a sport = (Degree/360°) × 600

 
 

 Name of sports
 Number of students
 
 

 Badminton
 125
 
 

 Tennis
 75
 
 

 Chess
 90
 
 

 Cricket
 115
 
 

 Hockey
 195
 
 

**∴ The difference between the number of students playing chess and badminton is 35.i.e (125 - 90).so, the value of x lies between 32 and 38.**
